card.name: Sports rules about ball handling
card.fires_on: Function words and verbs inside sports rule descriptions, such as basketball, wheelchair basketball and soccer, especially around dribbling, time limits and what a player may do with the ball.

modes.label: Ball-handling rules
modes.description: Linking words inside rules about dribbling or touching the ball.
modes.example: It is a traveling violation to take more than two pushes on the wheels<< without>> a dribble of the ball.

modes.label: Time limits and conditions
modes.description: Words after a time limit or condition such as 24 seconds or as long as.
modes.example: Every team has 24 seconds to<< complete>> its attempt to score a basket.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of short time units like minute and seconds, and slightly favors daily, weekly and monthly.
card.plain: It marks sentences in sports rulebooks about what a player may do with the ball and within what time.
